name: Are there local ceiling height requirements for framing a basement ceiling in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: Are there local ceiling height requirements for framing a basement ceiling in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro area, basement ceiling framing must maintain specific finished ceiling height clearances set by local building codes, generally at least 7 feet for habitable rooms. Beams, ducts, and soffits are often permitted slightly lower clearances, usually around 6 feet 4 inches to 6 feet 6 inches depending on local municipal rules. Homeowners should verify where HVAC trunks and plumbing drains run before framing to make sure ceiling drops will still pass building inspections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most Denver-area jurisdictions require habitable basement ceilings to finish at 7 feet, with limited exceptions for soffits and beams.
